title: Cientista de Dados (Produto RH)
description:
Descrição da vaga

A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes.

Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade.

O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos.
  • Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos.
  • Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas.
  • Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados.
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final.
  • Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção.
  • Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prática com modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise exploratória de dados.
  • Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc.) e SQL.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models).
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Experiência prévia com dados de RH ou People Analytics.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização (ex: Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Dash, etc.).
  • Experiência com deployment de modelos em ambiente de produção.
  • Pós-graduação ou cursos especializados em Ciência de Dados ou IA.



Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: Cientista de Dados (Produto RH)
description:
Descrição da vaga

A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes.

Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade.

O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos.
  • Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos.
  • Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas.
  • Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados.
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final.
  • Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção.
  • Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Assistente de pesquisa
description:
Assistente de Pesquisa – Ciências Regulatórias (Campo)


Este profissional será responsável por apoiar a condução de ensaios regulatórios de campo com cana-de-açúcar, realizando atividades de plantio, avaliações, coleta e registro de dados experimentais. Atuará garantindo a qualidade, rastreabilidade e organização das informações necessárias para a elaboração e submissão do dossiê regulatório, conforme os prazos do pipeline de biotecnologia.


Principais rotinas e responsabilidades

  • Conduzir ensaios de biotecnologia em campo (LPMAs), incluindo plantio, avaliações agronômicas e colheita de eventos transgênicos, conforme protocolos experimentais.
  • Executar ensaios em condições controladas (estufa e laboratório), seguindo normas de biossegurança para OGM.
  • Preparar kits de coleta, planos de estudo e livros de campo, garantindo organização e disponibilidade de materiais para ensaios.
  • Registrar métodos, materiais, equipamentos e resultados em planilhas, formulários e sistemas, assegurando rastreabilidade e integridade dos dados experimentais.
  • Apoiar o time de Supply Chain no monitoramento das entregas e qualidade do material coletado em campo para ensaios regulatórios.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de protocolos agronômicos e regulatórios aplicáveis aos ensaios com cana-de-açúcar geneticamente modificada.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares envolvidas no pipeline de biotecnologia.


Formação

  • Graduação em Agronomia ou Biologia.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência com manejo agronômico de culturas (cana-de-açúcar ou milho).

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH \"B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de Luiziânia - GO


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (inglês fluente)

Experiência Requerida

  • Experiência recomendada: Atuação em desenvolvimento de aplicações de BI.
  • Capacidade de identificar riscos técnicos e de segurança, bem como propor ações de mitigação.
  • Experiência prática com práticas de Gerenciamento de Configuração e Liberação (Configuration & Release Management).
  • Participação em modificações de software durante os testes de integração.
  • Compreensão dos requisitos dos stakeholders e documentação desses requisitos sob orientação.
  • Propor mudanças para melhorar a eficiência e/ou reduzir custos operacionais ou de manutenção.
  • Criar boas práticas e propor melhorias.
  • Levantar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, incluindo requisitos de segurança da informação, junto aos stakeholders, e documentá-los.

Competências Obrigatórias

  • Experiência comprovada na construção e gerenciamento de workflows de ETL e jobs no Databricks.
  • Forte expertise em Python, SQL e frameworks de processamento distribuído de dados (ex.: Spark).
  • Conhecimento prático em desenvolvimento Python.
  • Base sólida em controle de versão utilizando Git.
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps.
  • Entendimento de Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters e SQL Warehouses.
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory.
  • Facilidade no uso de ferramentas de linha de comando (CLI) e scripts (ex.: Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).
  • Familiaridade com app registrations e service principals.

Competências Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento dos setores industrial, automotivo ou de logística.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Work Model :Remote

Location :Brazil/ Latam

  • Elixir OR Ruby + React, Typescript, NodeJS, etc - If candidates have either/or experience with just Elixir or just Ruby, please ensure they have front end AND back end experience.

What You Get To Do Every Day

- Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that directly contributes to company-wide initiatives

- Develop using interesting technologies — Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

- Have significant input into technical decisions that will shape the future of our software systems

- Learn something new, whether it’s a new software design pattern or new initiative to push the company forward

- Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to your peers

- Pair up with a team member to work together on features

- Deploy user-facing code to production


Skills/Experience

- 5+ years professional software development experience

- Fluency with either Elixir or Ruby

- Proficient with the latest versions of ECMAScript (JavaScript) as well as HTML and CSS

- Experience with React and common tools used in the wider React ecosystem, such as Node.js and npm

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods






Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.

Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.

Job Description

Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.

Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.

Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.

Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: CLM Functional Support Analyst
description:
About UST

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven organization where people, purpose, and technology come together to create meaningful impact. With a strong people-first culture, we empower our teams to innovate, collaborate, and grow while delivering value to our clients and communities worldwide.

We 're looking for aCLM Functional Support Analyst to provides functional support for Contract Lifecycle Management platforms, handling incidents and service requests, supporting end users, and ensuring smooth contract operations across legal, procurement, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support for CLM-related incidents and service requests (L1/L2).
  • Log, categorize, prioritize, and track tickets using ITSM tools.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting and functional analysis before escalating to L2/L3 or technical teams.
  • Support users with contract creation, templates, clause libraries, approval workflows, and role-based access.
  • Perform basic CLM system configuration (templates, fields, workflows, user roles).
  • Monitor CLM integrations with ERP/CRM systems and identify data synchronization issues.
  • Support UAT activities, regression testing, and release validation.
  • Maintain user documentation and knowledge base articles.
  • Provide end-user training and onboarding support.
  • Ensure SLA compliance and provide basic reporting on ticket trends.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in CLM functional support or functional analysis roles.
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle processes and legal/procurement workflows.
  • Experience with CLM platforms such as Icertis, Agiloft, Conga, Sirion, SAP Ariba, or similar.
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Basic understanding of ERP/CRM integrations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced in English (B2+)

Why Join UST?

At UST, you will work in a collaborative and inclusive environment where innovation, learning, and personal growth are encouraged. You will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, work with global teams, and build solutions that truly make a difference.

Equal Opportunity Statement

UST is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Equity Employer . We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

About the Role

We’re hiring an Accounting Assistant to support payroll, invoicing, HR coordination, and financial administration within a staffing-focused environment.

This role requires strong attention to detail, comfort with compliance processes, and the ability to work independently while supporting cross-functional teams.


Key Responsibilities

Payroll & Invoicing

  • Ensure timely processing of weekly payroll and invoicing, including PO tracking.
  • Enter payroll data accurately and coordinate approvals.
  • Update CRM systems related to invoicing and payroll.


Accounting & Financial Support

  • Manage Accounts Payable.
  • Assist with Sales Tax returns.
  • Maintain and organize cloud-based financial files.
  • Produce and maintain Excel spreadsheets for reporting and tracking.
  • Update sales reports regularly.


HR & Compliance Support

  • Set up candidates across multiple states.
  • Oversee new employee onboarding and I-9 administration.
  • Act as liaison with HR and Benefits vendors.
  • Support compliance with CA state and federal labor laws.


Process & Systems Support

  • Translate operational processes into written SOPs.
  • Update internal training library as procedures evolve.
  • Work within databases and Applicant Tracking Systems.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Invoicing and Payroll Administration.
  • Proficient in QuickBooks Desktop Pro Plus 2022.
  • Strong Excel skills.
  • Experience with external payroll processors (Paylocity preferred).
  • Experience with databases and ATS systems (Bullhorn preferred).
  • Familiarity with CA state and federal labor laws.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

We’re hiring an Accounting Assistant to support payroll, invoicing, HR coordination, and financial administration within a staffing-focused environment.

Payroll & Invoicing

  • Translate operational processes into written SOPs.

title: Account Executive Brazil
description:
Localização

Brasil (remoto)

Disponibilidade para reuniões presenciais estratégicas

Sobre a Cybervision

A Cybervision é uma plataforma moderna de PAM (Privileged Access Management), criada para empresas que precisam de segurança imediata, visibilidade total e controle real sobre acessos privilegiados. Nosso foco é entregar valor rápido, com implantação ágil, monitoramento ativo e abordagem orientada a risco e negócio.

Responsabilidades

• Atuar na abertura de novos clientes no mercado brasileiro, com foco em médias e grandes empresas

• Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas: prospecção, diagnóstico, apresentação, negociação e fechamento

• Identificar dores reais relacionadas a acessos privilegiados, identidade, compliance e risco operacional

• Trabalhar de forma consultiva, traduzindo conceitos técnicos de cibersegurança em valor de negócio

• Atuar em conjunto com times de pré-vendas e engenharia para construção de propostas técnicas e comerciais

• Desenvolver e manter um pipeline previsível, com foco em resultados e recorrência

• Apoiar a construção da estratégia de entrada e posicionamento da Cybervision no Brasil

• Manter relacionamento próximo com decisores (CIO, CISO, CTO, Segurança, Infra e Risco)

Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência comprovada como Account Executive ou Hunter B2B em tecnologia ou cibersegurança

• Domínio de conceitos de cibersegurança, especialmente:

• PAM (Privileged Access Management)

• IAM / Identity

• Acesso remoto seguro

• Compliance (ISO 27001, LGPD, SOX – diferencial)

• Capacidade de conduzir vendas complexas e consultivas

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos e executivos

• Perfil hunter, orientado a metas e crescimento

• Autonomia, disciplina e visão estratégica de mercado

• Inglês

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

• Experiência com soluções de PAM, ZTNA, Zero Trust etc…

• Carteira ativa de contatos em TI, Segurança da Informação ou Infraestrutura

• Vivência em vendas de SaaS B2B

O que oferecemos

• Atuação em um produto estratégico e de alto valor no mercado de cibersegurança

• Autonomia real para construir mercado e gerar impacto

• Modelo de remuneração competitivo (fixo + variável)

• Possibilidade de crescimento junto com a expansão da Cybervision no Brasil

• Contato direto com liderança e participação ativa na estratégia da empresa

Perfil que buscamos

  • Buscamos alguém que entenda segurança de verdade, saiba vender valor (não apenas produto) e queira fazer parte da construção de uma nova referência em PAM no Brasil.

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job

Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).

Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)

Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%

Key Responsibilities May Include:

  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.

Experience- What you will bring

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).
  • Procurement/Purchasing Experience +5 years
  • Contract negotiations.
  • Customer service minded.

Skills & Knowledge

Strong Negotiation and commercial contracting skills specially in professional services,

facilities and maintenance (MRO).

• Use of computer tools such as Microsoft Excel, Coupa, CLMs.

• Knowledge of plant operations preferred.

• This role demands continuous interaction with key stakeholders within Brambles Supply

Chain and Corporate Business.

• Data Analytics (Intermediate level Excel to include Pivot tables, formulas, etc.) with

development potential.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us

Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.

We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.

We're Looking for You!

Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.

Your Role:

  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product

What We Need from You:

Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus

What We Offer

  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers

Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance


About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)

title: Suporte Python Tech Ops
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Solucionar problemas de suporte e solicitações técnicas relacionadas a sistemas de produção.
  • Conduzir análises técnicas aprofundadas de incidentes, realizando investigações.
  • Monitorar, relatar e solucionar problemas de pipeline de dados e sistemas de back-end
  • Analisar fluxos de trabalho e criar relatórios de defeitos / falhas detalhados

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Proficiência em depuração de problemas técnicos;
  • Proficiente em SQL e familiarizado com ecossistemas de Big Data como Cassandra, Flink, Kafka e outras tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento de scripts com Python ou linguagens similares para automatizar tarefas e solucionar problemas de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência em depuração de API Requests e problemas de respostas usando ferramentas como Charles, logs de rede ou métodos semelhantes;
  • Experiência com implementação e administração de ferramentas de monitoramento, registro e telemetria (por exemplo, Splunk, Prometheus, etc.).
  • Ingles avançado para escrita e conversação (obrigatório, projeto internacional).

title: Supervisor de Experiência
description:
Quando você pensa na Riachuelo, você pensa em nossas lojas, correto? Mas já parou para pensar o que acontece até nossas lojas receberem as coleções que conquistam o Brasil ano após ano?

Hoje somos mais de 30 mil criadores de possibilidades espalhados por todo o território nacional, atuando em diversas áreas construindo a Moda que inspira o Brasil.

Além das mais de 430 lojas das marcas Riachuelo, Casa Riachuelo, Fan Lab e Carter´s, c ontamos com times de Corporativo, Fábrica, Centro de distribuições, Contact Center e da nossa financeira, a Midway e muitas outras frentes que atuam juntas em um modelo de negócio integrado que garante que sejamos únicos no mercado brasileiro.

Trabalhamos com moda para criar impacto positivo diretamente em nosso país e amamos o que fazemos . A nossa cultura guia nossas ações e nossas relações, reforçando nossa essência brasileira, acolhedora e empreendedora.

Nosso time de Loja está em busca de um Supervisor Vendas Assistidas para compor a

equipe!

Lembramos que nossas oportunidades são para todos. Na Riachuelo, você encontra

um ambiente diverso, com respeito e empatia, em que cuidamos dos RCHLOVERS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Os desafios da função são:

Responsável pelos departamentos de perfumaria, eletrônicos, óculos ou relógios, realizando a gestão da equipe, garantindo a execução dos procedimentos operacionais e a entrega dos resultados.

  • Mobilizar e treinar sua equipe para o melhor atendimento ao cliente;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas;
  • Diagnosticar e propor alternativas que melhorem resultados;
  • Garantir a execução de procedimentos operacionais, alterações de preços, reposição de produtos e organização dos departamentos;
  • Garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos operacionais, entre eles, recebimento, armazenamento, reposição de produtos, trocas e balanços;
  • Acompanhar a concorrência, sugerir ações comerciais e melhoria em produtos;
  • Oferecer o cartão Riachuelo e os produtos financeiros aos clientes, mobilizando sua equipe para este fim;
  • Definir planejamento de horários, escalas e banco de horas da loja junto com equipe gerencial;
  • Conduzir reuniões com a equipe de loja;
  • Selecionar e treinar novos colaboradores;
  • Aplicar treinamentos conforme padrão da empresa;
  • Realizar a avaliação de desempenho e feedback para colaboradores;
  • Identificar e desenvolver os talentos para sucessão (PRI);
  • Acompanhar visitas de outras áreas da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações:

É muito importante que você tenha e/ou saiba:

  • Formação superior completa ou cursando.
  • Disponibilidade de horários para fechamento de loja, finais de semana e feriados.
  • Experiência com telefonia e perfumaria.

Informações adicionais:

E quais são os benefícios?

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida em grupo
  • Totalpass
  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Descontos na Riachuelo
  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados

Responsável pelos departamentos de perfumaria, eletrônicos, óculos ou relógios, realizando a gestão da equipe, garantindo a execução dos procedimentos operacionais e a entrega dos resultados.

  • Mobilizar e treinar sua equipe para o melhor atendimento ao cliente;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas;
  • Diagnosticar e propor alternativas que melhorem resultados;
  • Garantir a execução de procedimentos operacionais, alterações de preços, reposição de produtos e organização dos departamentos;
  • Garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos operacionais, entre eles, recebimento, armazenamento, reposição de produtos, trocas e balanços;
  • Acompanhar a concorrência, sugerir ações comerciais e melhoria em produtos;
  • Oferecer o cartão Riachuelo e os produtos financeiros aos clientes, mobilizando sua equipe para este fim;
  • Definir planejamento de horários, escalas e banco de horas da loja junto com equipe gerencial;
  • Conduzir reuniões com a equipe de loja;
  • Selecionar e treinar novos colaboradores;
  • Aplicar treinamentos conforme padrão da empresa;
  • Realizar a avaliação de desempenho e feedback para colaboradores;
  • Identificar e desenvolver os talentos para sucessão (PRI);
  • Acompanhar visitas de outras áreas da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações:

É muito importante que você tenha e/ou saiba:

  • Formação superior completa ou cursando.
  • Disponibilidade de horários para fechamento de loja, finais de semana e feriados.
  • Experiência com telefonia e perfumaria.

E quais são os benefícios?

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida em grupo
  • Totalpass
  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Descontos na Riachuelo
  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados

title: Analista Contábil Sr
description:
Requisitos Técnicos

· Experiência sólida (mínimo 5 anos) em contabilidade geral, fechamento mensal e demonstrações financeiras.

· Domínio de normas CPC/IFRS e legislação societária brasileira.

· Conhecimento avançado em Excel (fórmulas, Tabelas Dinâmicas, Power Query) e ERP (QuickBooks, TOTVS, ou similar).

· Experiência em conciliar intercompany, ativos fixos, provisões, ajustes de resultado e fechamento contábil completo.

· Inglês Fluente.

.Conhecimento em Microsoft Dynamics 365


Responsabilidades Principais

· Assegurar processos e atividades de contas a pagar e contas a receber

· Assegurar as conciliações contábeis completas e revisões de contas patrimoniais e de resultado.

· Elaborar e analisar demonstrações contábeis (Balanço, DRE, DFC).

· Controlar e contabilizar provisões, rateios e lançamentos manuais complexos.

· Assegurar a correta classificação contábil e a aderência ao plano de contas corporativo.

· Apoiar a auditoria externas.

· Revisar lançamentos de folha, ativos fixos, intercompany, impostos e custos.

· Realizar fechamento contábil mensal e reconciliações entre contabilidade e fiscal.

· Manter interface constante com áreas Financeira, Fiscal, RH, Contas a Pagar/Receber.

· Garantir conformidade com CPCs (ex: CPC 00, 27, 04, 25, 32, 46, 48, 47, 15) e princípios IFRS.

· Apoiar a entrega e revisão das obrigações acessórias (ECD, ECF, DCTF, DIRF, etc.).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Cobol Mainframe Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar com manutenção e evolução de sistemas mainframe , buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Cobol Mainframe para atuar em ajustes estruturais de dados e modernizações técnicas.

Se você domina COBOL, DB2 e SQL , essa oportunidade pode ser ideal para você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar alterações em tabelas DB2 para adequação de CNPJ ao formato alfanumérico
  • Analisar e ajustar programas COBOL impactados pelas mudanças estruturais
  • Atuar na manutenção e atualização de ativos como Books e Sysins
  • Desenvolver e ajustar rotinas e procedimentos em SQL / Proc SQL
  • Apoiar testes, validações e acompanhamento de implantações
  • Garantir qualidade e consistência das alterações em ambiente mainframe

Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento COBOL Mainframe
  • Vivência com DB2 e SQL
  • Experiência com manutenção corretiva e evolutiva em sistemas legados
  • Conhecimento em análise de impacto e ajustes estruturais de dados
  • Boa comunicação e atenção a detalhes
  • Ter atuado em projetos relacionados a CNPJ alfanumérico
  • Experiência em projetos de adequação regulatória ou migração de dados
  • Conhecimento em ambientes financeiros ou bancários

Formato de trabalho

  • Modelo 100% remoto.

E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Climate and Energy Study (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Gen Z who are interested in participating in market research on Climate and Energy topics. The market research will be conducted in pair with your friend.



Qualifications:

  • Able to talk about the climate and the energy sector
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 60-minute interview conducted via MS Teams
  • Please note that you will be conducting the interview session with as a pair with your friend.


Compensation package - BRL 530 for a 60-minute online Interview per person.

title: Executive Assistant (Operations & Admin Focus) - 100% Remote
description:
Apply now:

About the Role

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support leadership with operational, HR, payroll, and administrative responsibilities.

This role is highly execution-focused and ideal for someone organized, proactive, and comfortable managing structured processes with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Administrative & Compliance

  • Manage bi-monthly safety emails and internal communications.
  • Oversee state licensing and registration tracking and renewals.
  • Maintain organized documentation and compliance records.

HR Support

  • Set up and monitor job postings.
  • Filter resumes and conduct initial candidate screenings.
  • Manage full onboarding process for new hires.
  • Coordinate employee termination and exit procedures.

Payroll & Finance Support

  • Manage payroll processing (currently manual process; final approval by leadership).
  • Handle Accounts Payable and billing coordination.
  • Work alongside accounting (AR and bookkeeping handled separately).

Operations Support

  • Support ERP system project management initiatives.
  • Schedule daily appointments for service technicians.
  • Assist project managers with time tracking coordination.

Executive Support

  • Manage and clean up executive email inbox.
  • Maintain task tracking and follow-ups.
  • Support day-to-day operational coordination.

Requirements

  • Strong Executive Assistant or Operations support experience.
  • Experience with payroll processing (manual systems preferred).
  • Experience with Accounts Payable and billing workflows.
  • HR administration experience (hiring, onboarding, exits).
  • Comfortable supporting ERP implementation or operational systems.
  • Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Strong English communication skills.

Apply now:

This is an external position to work at a WiseVAs client. Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that WiseVAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in WiseVAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.

title: Engenheiro de Exchange
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.

O que buscamos?

  • Especialista em Microsoft Exchange (On-Premises & Online) com foco em Segurança.

Principais responsabilidades técnicas:

  • Migração de Exchange On-Premises para Microsoft Exchange Online
  • Projetos e upgrades de Microsoft Exchange Server (2010, 2013, 2016, 2019)
  • Configuração híbrida, fluxo de e-mail (SMTP), DAG, alta disponibilidade e disaster recovery
  • Configuração de MX apontando para EOP ou gateways de terceiros
  • Scripting avançado em PowerShell
  • Health checks, troubleshooting avançado e recomendações de boas práticas

Infraestrutura & Identidade:

  • Arquitetura e administração de Active Directory (2008/2016)
  • Experiência sólida em ambientes on-premises
  • Cluster de Failover
  • Experiência comprovada em múltiplos projetos (mín. 5 anos em arquitetura, implantação e suporte)

Segurança e Compliance (diferencial importante):

  • Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (políticas de higiene de e-mail, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Threat Explorer, Quarantine, Advanced Hunting)
  • Microsoft Purview (retenção, rótulos de sensibilidade, DLP, eDiscovery; diferenciais: Insider Risk, Information Barriers e Communication Compliance)

CLT FULL + Benefícios

Contrato híbrido para **eventuais** viagens e visitas a cliente.

O que oferecemos?

· Contratação CLT;

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.

“O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).”

title: Principal Solution Architect
description:
Step into a strategic leadership role where your ideas shape the future of cloud data innovation. Join a fast‑growing Snowflake and cloud‑native consulting partner as the Senior Director of Data Engineering for LATAM. You’ll lead high‑impact data initiatives, guide technical strategy for key accounts, and elevate engineering excellence across the region. This remote position allows you to connect with teams from Brazil and Mexico while driving impactful data initiatives that propel business growth.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead Regional Data Engineering: Manage and mentor teams across LATAM, fostering innovation, growth, and consistent technical excellence.
  • Own Technical Delivery: Oversee end‑to‑end solution delivery for strategic accounts, ensuring high‑quality, scalable Snowflake and cloud data platforms.
  • Drive Strategy & Growth: Partner with Sales and executive stakeholders to identify opportunities, expand services, and deliver long‑term customer value.
  • Be a Trusted Advisor: Provide clear, actionable guidance on modern data architectures, cloud-native patterns, and platform maturity.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams in Brazil, Mexico, and global delivery to ensure alignment and successful outcomes.
  • Uplift Talent: Coach engineers, architects, and account teams in both technical depth and communication excellence.
  • Extreme Ownership: Proactively solve complex challenges, ensure accountability, and champion customer success.


What Makes You a Great Fit:


  • Proven record of high‑performance delivery in complex cloud data environments.
  • Strong ability to simplify technical complexity and influence architecture decisions.
  • Customer‑obsessed , entrepreneurial, and proactive approach to driving outcomes.
  • Inspiring leader who grows people, builds trust, and elevates team capabilities.
  • Thrives in a fast‑moving, rapidly scaling consultancy supporting Snowflake and cloud ecosystems.


Required Experience:


  • 10+ years as a hands‑on Solutions Architect or Data Engineering leader.
  • 2+ years consulting leadership with external clients.
  • Expertise designing and delivering production-grade solutions across Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP, or Databricks.
  • Strong Python, SQL, and experience building scalable pipelines and integrations
  • Demonstrated success managing Data Engineers and Solution Architects across distributed teams
  • Prior Revenue Generation experience for Enterprise clients.
  • Experience shaping technical strategy, roadmaps, and long-term customer partnerships
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and client-facing presentation skills
  • Ability to create detailed technical artifacts (POCs, roadmaps, architecture docs, diagrams)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field preferred


Technical Strengths (One or More):


  • Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks
  • Storage & distributed systems: S3, ADLS, HDFS, GCS, NoSQL stores
  • Data integration: Spark, Kafka, Streamsets, Matillion, Fivetran, NiFi, ADF, DMS, IICS
  • Multiple data source ingestion: APIs, databases, files, queues
  • Automated transformation: dbt, Spark, streaming pipelines
  • Orchestration: Airflow, Managed Airflow, Luigi, NiFi
  • Methodologies: Agile, Kimball, Data Vault

Descrição da Empresa GS Contadores e IGS Gestão Financeira

Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um estagiário para integrar a equipe da GS Contadores Associados Ltda e IGS Gestão Financeira em Belém, PA. title: Accounting Assistant
description:
The ideal candidate will be responsible for performing accounting and administrative duties. You will support our business growth and accounting department by processing invoices, transactions, expenses as well as updating our accounting database. This position will give you the opportunity to grow your accounting knowledge and experience.

Responsibilities

  • Process invoices and daily transactions and expenses
  • Perform administrative support functions
  • Update and maintain accounting database with data entry and reports
  • Handle monthly and quarterly reports
  • Handle day-to-day accounting duties including Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and payroll

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or a related field of study
  • 1-3 years' of experience working in Accounting
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly detail-oriented

title: Senior Kotlin Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a Senior Kotlin Software Engineer to join our team. You’ll design, build, and maintain backend services that power our applications, working closely with frontend and product teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure APIs.


What you will do :

  • Design and implement backend services using Kotlin and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by our applications.
  • Work with PostgreSQL databases, ensuring performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with product, frontend, and QA teams to deliver high-quality features.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following best practices.
  • Contribute to system design and architecture discussions.


What we expect from you:

  • 5 years of experience in software engineering.
  • Deep expertise with Kotlin and Spring Boot, including complex system design.
  • Proven experience designing scalable backend architectures.
  • Strong focus on performance, security, and reliability.
  • Ability to mentor junior/mid engineers and lead technical initiatives.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability practices.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Dax engineer
description:
Job Title: DAX Engineer (Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012)

Industry: Transportation & Supply Chain

Location: Remote

About the Role:

Our client is seeking a skilled DAX Engineer to enhance and maintain their on-prem Microsoft Dynamics AX environment. This role bridges technical development and business operations, working closely with stakeholders across transportation and supply chain functions. The ideal candidate is a Microsoft Dynamics AX specialist with strong technical skills and the ability to translate business needs into practical, scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop, configure, and maintain Microsoft Dynamics AX (AX 2012) solutions to support business operations.

Work within an on-prem AX environment, ensuring stability, reliability, and performance.

Design and implement technical solutions using C# and .NET.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
The Role

As a RevOps Strategist, you will be the primary client-facing partner for several of our SaaS clients. You’ll work closely with the Founder/CEO during your first 3–6 months, joining calls together and learning our methodology. Over time, you will take ownership of the client relationship—shaping their RevOps strategy, managing ongoing deliverables, and guiding a team of RevOps Analysts on execution.

This role blends:

  • Client strategy & communication
  • RevOps problem-solving & system architecture
  • Hands-on tool knowledge (especially HubSpot)
  • Scoping, prioritizing, and quality-checking technical work

This is not a “ticket-taker” role. You’ll be a strategic partner, trusted advisor, and cross-functional operator helping early- and growth-stage SaaS companies scale their go-to-market operations.

What You’ll Do

RevOps Strategy

  • Partner with clients to build and evolve their RevOps strategy across the full funnel (Marketing, Sales, CS).
  • Proactively identify gaps, opportunities, and process improvements.
  • Translate business goals into concrete RevOps initiatives and technical requirements.
  • Provide perspective on best practices across areas such as:
  • Lead flow design
  • Pipeline management
  • Process automation & workflow optimization
  • CRM governance
  • GTM integrations
  • Reporting & analytics
  • AI implementation for GTM workflows

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for 3–6 clients.
  • Run weekly/bi-weekly client meetings, deliver updates, and document decisions.
  • Communicate proactively via Slack and email with clarity, professionalism, and consistency.
  • Build trusted relationships with GTM leaders (Marketing, Sales, RevOps, CS).

Implementation Leadership & Quality Assurance

  • Work with our RevOps Analysts to scope, prioritize, and assign technical work.
  • Review deliverables for accuracy, strategy alignment, and data integrity.
  • Jump into tools directly (especially HubSpot) when needed to troubleshoot or validate.
  • Ensure high-quality execution that reflects Floodlight Growth standards.

About You

You are a hybrid: part RevOps strategist, part systems thinker, part client partner. You’re comfortable both solving a strategic GTM problem and advising on how to execute it in HubSpot.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on RevOps or Marketing/Sales Ops experience.
  • Advanced HubSpot experience (CRM, workflows, custom objects, lead routing, reporting).
  • Experience with Salesforce, Clay, sales engagement tools, and GTM integrations strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience working across the full revenue funnel.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable.
  • Ability to turn a business conversation into clear technical requirements.
  • Comfortable collaborating with technical implementers—and reviewing their work.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS company (ideally venture-backed).
  • Experience in consulting, client services, or agency environments.
  • Familiarity with automation platforms (Zapier, n8n, Workato).
  • Strong analytical skills (e.g., Looker, Snowflake, HubSpot reporting).

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

description:
About the role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Portuguese-speaking Customer Support Specialist to join our remote team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our Portuguese-speaking users and our global operations team, ensuring world-class support via Zendesk while contributing to the localized growth of the Airbrush app.

What you will do:

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora | C# - Asp Net
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


DESAFIO


  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web utilizando ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, e outras tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Implementar e otimizar soluções utilizando HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, e JSon, garantindo alta performance e usabilidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter banco de dados SQL Server, incluindo a criação e otimização de triggers, stored procedures e aplicação de regras de normalização.
  • Integrar e consumir WebServices (SOAP e REST) nas aplicações desenvolvidas.
  • Controlar as mudanças no desenvolvimento de software para assegurar a estabilidade e evolução contínua dos projetos.
  • Identificar e corrigir problemas no código, bem como propor melhorias e oportunidades de refatoração para manter a qualidade do software.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para garantir que as soluções atendam aos requisitos de negócios e qualidade.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA


  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Entendimento de processos de desenvolvimento, qualidade e maturidade de software.
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Linguagem de programação: domínio de aplicação e entendimento de sintaxe e desempenho de linguagens como ASP.NET c#, Java script, Json, Bootstrap
  • Experiência com WEB JS/Jquery/Ajax, Webforms, Bootstrap, HTML, JSon e CSS, SQL Server, incluindo normalização, triggers, e stored procedures.
  • Conhecimento em SOAP e REST.
  • Habilidade analítica para detectar problemas e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Proatividade e boa comunicação para colaborar com diferentes equipes.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER


  • Experiência prévia no mercado de corretoras de seguros.

title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:
Digital Web Experience Solution Architect

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina

Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect & implement scalable, secure, performant, and resilient approaches for brand websites that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Use modern CMS systems and MACH principles
  • Enable personalization, performance optimization, and measurable business outcomes
  • Comply with CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other data privacy and regulatory requirements
  • Manage current state documents including diagrams, operational runbooks, and future-state roadmaps
  • Align digital marketing strategies within the platform architecture and guidelines.
  • Apply principles around people, process, information, and technology to design
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the digital experience.
  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with industry trends in digital experience platforms and architecture, continuously evaluating emerging technologies and best practices to keep our brand experiences cutting-edge.
  • Provide guidance on selecting technologies and tools that also support compliance and data protection.
  • Operational Ownership to ensure uptime and reliability of all brand sites through proactive monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization including incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve architectural challenges, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Mentor and support other architects and engineers within the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Provide Legacy Support for existing sites during migration to MACH architecture where needed.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital experiences.

Required expertise in:

  • Full Stack Development (Frontend: React; Backend: CMS, API-first).
  • Modern CMS solutions (headless and traditional), integration patterns, and best practices.
  • MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).
  • Cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and cloud-native deployments.
  • Relational database design and optimization; advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, frameworks, and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience integrating Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) for unified customer profiles and personalization.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.
